function addLiquidity( uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min, uint256 deadline ) external nonReentrant ensure(deadline) returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1, uint256 mintedShares) { require(amount0Desired > 0 && amount1Desired > 0, "zero amounts"); if (totalShares == 0) { (amount0, amount1) = (amount0Desired, amount1Desired); } else { uint256 amount1Optimal = (amount0Desired * reserve1) / reserve0; if (amount1Optimal <= amount1Desired) { (amount0, amount1) = (amount0Desired, amount1Optimal); } else { uint256 amount0Optimal = (amount1Desired * reserve0) / reserve1; (amount0, amount1) = (amount0Optimal, amount1Desired); } } require(amount0 >= amount0Min && amount1 >= amount1Min, "slippage exceeded"); if (totalShares == 0) { mintedShares = _sqrt(amount0 * amount1); require(mintedShares > MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY, "insufficient initial liquidity"); mintedShares -= MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY; totalShares = MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY; shares[address(0)] = MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY; emit Transfer(address(0), address(0), MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY); } else { uint256 s0 = (amount0 * totalShares) / reserve0; uint256 s1 = (amount1 * totalShares) / reserve1; mintedShares = s0 < s1 ? s0 : s1; } require(mintedShares > 0, "insufficient liquidity minted"); reserve0 += amount0; reserve1 += amount1; totalShares += mintedShares; shares[msg.sender] += mintedShares; emit Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, mintedShares); emit LiquidityAdded(msg.sender, amount0, amount1, mintedShares); _pull(token0, amount0); _pull(token1, amount1); }
